sections.title: Proposed project
sections.value: I recommend evaluating the robot's command history and decide whether or not going through the trouble of rebooting the robot is worth the time.

sections.title: Business need
sections.value: We need to improve function overall. Expand upon issues to create more work to be done. Maximize the things we get done until we can get as close to perfect as possible.

sections.title: Expected value and beneficiaries
sections.value: 01: The company itself could fix the robot, find the owner, and reverse engineer it, turning it into a tool they could sell, or patent.  If we pour time into the robot, we could change the way that we operate.

sections.title: Included work
sections.value: We have the ownership. Scheduling, and our checklist according to W02-S03

sections.title: Excluded work
sections.value: Repair of the robot, only a look at what we could see about it.

sections.title: Technical feasibility
sections.value: Tools and read only exports support the review via the read only copies and exports.  The delayed access condition is a problem

sections.title: Operational feasibility
sections.value: QA window is necessary, so they must make sure that QA is always available.

sections.title: Cost and resource feasibility
sections.value: Equipment, tools, overtime, and assessment costs are excluded according to w02-S05

sections.title: Schedule feasibility
sections.value: Read-only exports cause problems/holdup. Engineering takes long to start, QA needs 2 days entirely. The time elapsed between individuals is where the 48 hours comes from so there must be calculations

sections.title: Known constraints
sections.value: Budget limits. Avoid the 3000 limit. Schedule limit. , 10 days isn't a lot.

sections.title: Risks and assumptions
sections.value: No availability from the QA's. Find out an alternative to a QA if they are unsure.

sections.title: Success measures and evidence
sections.value: They will go by the amount of authorization and and archive of tests.

sections.title: Rationale and conditions
sections.value:
W02-S02 shows that we can do it with our timeframe. W02-S05 provides us with the budget.
Work is limited, so I think that as long as we keep it solid, we can finish.

sections.title: Next authorization or information step
sections.value: Elias should have the department heads move forward to confirm availability. The sponsor will auth, or it wont.
